verdicts.reason: A: the halo circle has drifted to the right, so the can no longer sits inside it. 'Swipe up to shop' has been moved up under the tagline, which breaks the reading order. The headline runs almost to both side edges, and the NEW/LIMITED RUN badges are swapped, though they stay centred as one group under the copy. B has the same off-centre halo, promoted swipe text and nearly edge-to-edge headline, and also leaves the badges stranded in the bottom-left corner, cut off from the product and copy and jammed toward the edge, so the layout is lopsided.
